sources.content: Proposal EMB-207: drop debug logs at the Embrel edge agent. Debug lines make up about 60 percent of the log volume Embrel receives, yet engineers query them in fewer than 2 percent of searches. Storing them costs the team roughly 18,000 dollars a month. This proposal moves debug filtering from the central indexer to the edge agent that runs on each host. The change affects only lines with level debug or trace.

Each service can keep its debug logs by setting keep_debug: true in its embrel.yaml. The edge agent will still keep a sample of 1 in 100 debug lines for every service, tagged sampled=true, so recent examples stay searchable. The agent records dropped lines in the counter embrel_edge_dropped_lines_total. Rollout begins with 10 percent of hosts in the eu-west region and expands after one week without incidents. During an incident, engineers can lift the filter on one host for an hour with embrel debug-window.
